//: The parts an agent may use, in json-render's catalog terms. The extension draws only these, each as a cmux kit view; generate/generate.ts turns the same file into json-render's prompt.

Panel.description: A titled group on the app's card surface. Use one per widget.

Stack.description: Lays children out vertically (default) or horizontally.

Row.description: A list row with a title, optional subtitle and SF Symbol.

Button.description: A button. on.press runs an action.

TextField.description: A one-line text input. Bind value with $bindState. on.submit runs on Return.

Toggle.description: A switch with a label. Bind checked with $bindState or $bindItem.

Badge.description: A small count or status pill.

EmptyState.description: A centered empty or error message.

Spacer.description: Flexible space inside a horizontal Stack.
